grimoire-pope-honorius-1670b:
Two different books hide under the name Grimoire of Pope Honorius in the year 1670. This second printing differs substantially in content and order from its twin of the same date. The library keeps both, because students of the grimoire trade need to compare them rather than choose between them.

The prayers, conjurations, and spirit lists do not match across the two printings. Such drift was normal in a trade of cheap, secretive books copied and reworked by many hands. For bibliographers the pair is a delight. It shows a living text in motion, before print fixed it. A magician's spare copy, a scholar's evidence: this Honorius serves both.
